concepts.name: Sail windmill on a pole, 5 m, 8 cloth sails
parts: Pole: 2 x galvanised post tube 73 mm x 3.05 m (MX$545 each), sleeved
Guys: 30 m of 3/16 in steel cable (MX$27/m), clamps, 3 buried anchors
Used bicycle (bearing + chain drive), bolts, plywood hub disc (MX$599)
8 spars: 1 in steel conduit 3 m (MX$249 each), bowsprit + stay ropes
Sails: polyethylene tarp 4.87 x 3.65 m (MX$765), cord
concepts.notes: Spars need a bowsprit with a stay rope to each tip (unstayed conduit yields above about 8 m/s). Furl or untie sails above 10 m/s.
